decision_reference: user conversation 2026-10-10: selected payload-size ceiling approximately 1.734 USD
why_blocked: The 1.73376 USD calculation assumes serialized UTF-8 bytes plus a fixed 512-token framing allowance.
Official OpenAI documentation provides exact preflight token counting for the Responses API, not a binding Chat Completions framing ceiling for this locked runtime.
The release contract therefore continues to reserve the documented 400000-token context window per request.
Canonical allocation, prior cost, unknown exposure, remaining allocation, and prior-host sealing are also not reconciled.
